description: MCP protocol contract v2: dual-era server (0.4.0). The legacy initialize-based version matrix stays frozen in mcp/versions-v1.json and is unchanged by 0.4.0; this file is the single authoritative rulebook for the stateless modern 2026-07-28 era (per-request _meta, server/discover, resultType/ttlMs/cacheScope envelopes, error mapping) and for how both eras coexist in one process. Additive: no frozen v1 artifact is modified.

supersedes.mcp/versions-v1.json#/modernProtocol: versions-v1.json records status 'out-of-scope-0.3.2'; 0.4.0 implements the modern era as specified here.

legacy.note: 0.4.0 does not change any legacy request/response byte. Requests without modern per-request _meta, and all traffic when ADVISERS_MCP_MODERN=off, take this path (verified by a golden byte diff in test/mcp-modern.test.js).

eraDetection.rule: A request is modern iff method != 'initialize' and params._meta contains io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion or io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities; every other request is legacy. The era is never inferred from prior requests (no connection state).
eraDetection.initialize: Always legacy, even when it carries stray modern _meta: it answers with the legacy handshake result (echo/fallback matrix from versions-v1.json).
eraDetection.unrelatedMeta: params._meta without a modern protocol key (e.g. only progressToken) stays legacy; the era is never guessed from unrelated metadata.

tools/list.modern: same tool catalogue as legacy, wrapped in the modern envelope (cached)

tools/call.modern: same payload and audit as legacy; content[0].text is byte-identical

resources/list.modern: same resource catalogue as legacy, wrapped in the modern envelope (cached)

resources/read.modern: same contents text as legacy (private, ttlMs 0); unknown uri => -32602

discover.requestBody: no body parameters beyond the standard params._meta

resultType.note: Every success result carries resultType=complete, including tool results with isError=true. input_required is never emitted (no multi-round-trip support).

resultEnvelope.errors: JSON-RPC error responses never carry resultType.

pagination.note: Any client-supplied cursor on tools/list or resources/list is rejected with -32602.

malformedMeta.when: a required _meta field is missing or has the wrong type

unknownMethod.when: method is not in the modern allowlist (includes initialize/ping in the modern era)

unknownResource.when: resources/read uri is not one of the 5 catalogue URIs

toolExecutionFailure.note: Tool execution failures are not JSON-RPC errors (same convention as legacy).

modern.dataPath: Modern handlers call the exact same read-model and audit functions as the legacy dispatcher; the era layer only changes the result envelope. tools/call content[0].text and resources/read contents[0].text are byte-identical between eras for the same request (asserted by tests).
modern.audit: Unchanged: tools/call writes the same mcp.* audit entry, resources/read writes resource:<uri>, server/discover and list methods write nothing.
modern.clearance: Unchanged: per-item clearance filtering, protectedExcluded counts, output caps and the 64 KiB byte budget run before the envelope is applied.

disableSwitch.effect: Every request takes the legacy path (the exact 0.3.2 surface): server/discover answers -32601 and modern _meta is ignored. One process restart reverts without a CLI flag.

nonGoals: readonly profile switching (not an MCP protocol feature)

conformance.payloadSource: mcp/responses-v1.schema.json ($defs are reused for the payload of tools/list, tools/call, resources/list and resources/read after the modern envelope keys resultType/ttlMs/cacheScope/_meta are removed)
